title: A Case-Bundle Operating Model for Coding Agents in OpenFOAM-Based CFD
abstract: arXiv:2609.11941v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: General-purpose coding agents can set up computational fluid dynamics (CFD) cases, execute solvers, and manage remote jobs. Reviewable and reusable work additionally depends on persistent engineering context and evidence. We present a case-bundle operating model with two modes. Build supports agent-assisted case development under engineering review. Replay applies a reviewed case to new variants. We used this model in an OpenFOAM-7 interFoam study for screening injector designs. GPT-5.5 in Codex helped develop a case bundle containing the simulation configuration, geometry-processing and meshing procedures, remote-execution scripts, post-processing code, and review records. The bundle was replayed to execute and post-process 140 Stereolithography (STL) geometry variants on a remote high-performance computing system. A separate replay exercise used the Pi coding agent as the runtime with four different LLM backends. All four runs succeede

translated_title: 面向OpenFOAM计算流体力学的编码代理算例捆绑包运行模型
translated_abstract: 通用编码代理能够建立计算流体力学（CFD）算例、执行求解器并管理远程作业。然而，可审查和可复用的工作还依赖于持久的工程上下文与证据。我们提出了一种包含两种模式的算例捆绑包运行模型：Build模式支持在工程审查下由代理辅助进行算例开发，Replay模式则将经过审查的算例应用于新的变体。我们将该模型应用于基于OpenFOAM-7 interFoam求解器的喷油器设计筛选研究。Codex中的GPT-5.5协助开发了一个算例捆绑包，其中包含仿真配置、几何处理与网格划分流程、远程执行脚本、后处理代码以及审查记录。该捆绑包通过重放方式在远程高性能计算系统上执行并后处理了140个立体光刻（STL）几何变体。另一项独立的重放实验使用Pi编码代理作为运行时，搭配四种不同的LLM后端，全部四次运行均取得成功。
tldr: 提出了一种Build/Replay双模式的算例捆绑包运行模型，使编码代理能够在工程审查下开展可审查、可复用的CFD仿真工作，并通过重放在远程HPC系统上批量处理140个喷油器几何变体验证了其有效性。
en_tdlr: A case-bundle operating model with Build and Replay modes enables coding agents to perform reviewable and reusable CFD workflows, validated by replaying a reviewed OpenFOAM bundle to process 140 injector geometry variants on a remote HPC system.
